d.title: Lupin III: Prison of the Past
d.jp: ルパン三世 プリズン・オブ・ザ・パスト
syn: Lupin Sansei: Prison of the Past
d.synopsis: The episode focuses on Lupin's gang descending upon the Kingdom of Dorrente in order to rescue a famous thief who has been detained. While this takes place, the most notorious thieves from around the world gather in the kingdom.
